name: untrusted
title: Untrusted packages
description: ONLY_TRUSTED meets an unsigned source: exit 8 (need-untrusted) without any ErrorCode. packagekitd very likely swallows the backend's error 51 (cannot-update-repo-unsigned) for an ONLY_TRUSTED transaction and reports only the exit code (not verified against the 1.3.4 source, which is not on this machine); this is the stricter model: a client must map exit 8 alone.
